valuation.method: Fixed-income / exchangeable debenture valuation (12-month horizon): pull-to-par and credit-spread sensitivity on Comcast Holdings Corp. 2.0% Exchangeable Subordinated Debentures due 2029 (guaranteed by Comcast Corporation), plus embedded reference-equity exchange option value.

bear.driver: Benchmark rate rise or subordinated credit spread widening
bear.assumption: Discounted price reflects ~10% downside on wider subordinated spreads and minimal exchange-option value

base.driver: Gradual pull-to-par toward 2029 maturity with stable Comcast credit spreads
base.assumption: 12 months of carry/pull-to-par accretion at stable subordinated debt yields

bull.driver: Rate cuts / spread compression and/or reference-equity appreciation
bull.assumption: Tighter credit spreads and higher embedded exchange-option value lift price toward $72.00

valuation.implied_by_close: At $62.32, the 2.0% debenture trades at a discount to par, pricing in subordinated duration/credit risk and limited near-term exchange-option value; no named equity analyst targets exist for comparison.
valuation.sensitivity: A 100 bps parallel shift in subordinated discount yield over a ~2-year remaining effective duration moves the 12-month target by roughly $1.25-$1.50 (~2.0-2.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Comcast Corporation consolidated net leverage, free cash flow, and 10-Q/10-K Long-Term Debt / ZONES carrying value disclosures
valuation.next_disclosure: Comcast Corporation Q4 / FY2026 Form 10-K (expected February 2027)

analyst_notes: CCZ (Comcast Holdings Corp. 2.0% Exchangeable Subordinated Debentures due 2029, ZONES) is a listed debt/exchangeable security rather than common equity, so Wall Street equity analysts do not publish stock ratings or 12-month price targets for it. Coverage is marked unavailable with an empty events list.
